messages:
nina: Heads-up: customer requires BYOK import into our HSM proxy but explicitly wants escrowless custody and a legally verifiable audit trail. Sales needs a short Q&A for the SOW about RBAC windows, signed export format, and IR SLOs. Tagging @varun @beth

varun: Quick Q: do they want persistent operator accounts or strictly JIT? My recommendation: JIT-only for import operations (STS session with MFA + hardware token), TTL = 2h, requires ticket_id and 2 approvers. Persistent accounts only for `kms-admin` (no import perms).

beth: On audit trail: require signed daily exports (ed25519) + RFC3161 timestamp token. Include HSM attestation: serial, firmware SHA256, and an HSM-signed nonce if vendor supports. Additionally write a Merkle-root over the day's events and publish to our transparency log (read-only) so customer can verify integrity independently.

nina: Legal also asked about time sync and proof-of-tamper detection. Any minimal requirements we can promise?

beth: We should require NTP/TSA timestamping for signing service and store the TSA response with the bundle. For tamper evidence: bundle = gzipped JSONL events + signer cert + RFC3161 timestamp + merkle proof. Store bundle in Object Lock (governance) and mirror to customer S3 if they want. Also keep a cross-account notarization copy (separate signing account).

infra-bot: ticket-created: ENGSEC-4021 (BYOK escrowless onboarding checklist)

varun: IR SLO sketch: 1) Detect suspicious import or firmware mismatch -> immediate automated revoke of operator tokens (<=2 minutes). 2) Snapshot & sign the forensic export (<=4 hours). 3) Provide initial customer notification within 4 hours and a full signed bundle within 24 hours. If firmware CVE is confirmed, block further imports and escalate to P0.

nina: That timeline looks good. Any blockers for blocking imports based on firmware hash?

beth: Implementation note: add a pre-import allowlist check in the proxy: require header with hsm_model + firmware_hash and compare against allowlist. If missing or mismatched deny import and create P1 automatically. We'll need a small onboarding form for sales to capture HSM serial + firmware for allowlisting.

varun: Ops note: JIT flow policy pseudo: \n```\nAllow if principal.role == "importer" && context.ticket_id != null && context.mfa == true && context.jit_expires > now\n```\nEnforce via STS session tags and Lambda authorizer in the proxy.

nina: Action items: Varun -> draft JIT RBAC + ticket template, Beth -> signed export spec (include merkle + RFC3161 + storage locations), Ops -> add pre-import allowlist checkbox to onboarding form. I'll attach this thread to the SOW and loop in Legal. Thanks :thumbsup:
